about: Apps Dấu labels “Đề xuất” for underlining (D13). Every app types without underline until the user turns it on. Labeled: Microsoft Edge, Brave, Arc and the Electron apps of docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. Chrome, Firefox and VS Code lost the label on 10/11/2026 after in-place replacement measured right. Terminal is not suggested. Bundle IDs from docs/COMPATIBILITY.md section 3.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.note: Electron. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal after the M6 late-answer fix (14 of 15 runs right; the wrong run was not a replacement-position error); label removed.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.note: Chromium. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal after the M6 late-answer fix; label removed.

apps.name: Microsoft Edge
apps.note: Chromium (Microsoft Edge Framework). Measured 30/10/2026: in-place wrong at 0 and 5 ms, right from 10 ms; underline right at 0 ms.

apps.name: Cursor
apps.note: Electron (built from VS Code 1.128). Measured 10/11/2026 (3.29.15): the agents prompt is right at 5, 20 and 100 ms; in the editor in-place is right at 100 ms and at 20 ms after the M6 fixes, wrong at 5 ms and in a burst from the first key of a new document; underline right at 5 ms. The editor counts positions from the start of the word.

apps.name: Figma
apps.note: Electron, content drawn on a canvas. Not measured.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.note: Gecko. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal after the M6 late-answer fix; label removed.
